title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the second race of the Classic Triple Crown, the Japanese Derby. I ask dorm leader Hishi Amazon to wake up Seiun Sky so she won't be late.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokyo Racecourse is fired up to see the big three face off. The clear favorite to win is Special Week, to whom victory in the Derby has been a personal dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But, of course, she's not the only one dreaming to win. The big three battle once again!
